note: Adapted from the original English description in Emerson 1925, Termites of Kartabo, British Guiana, covering the imago and the major and minor soldiers; the worker was not described. The measurement labels for the alate were garbled by OCR, so only the 6 legible items are given (body with wings, body without wings, pronotal width, hind tibia length, forewing length/width); the rest are omitted. The major soldier's left mandible length is also missing. The original comparison with R. nasutus and the original description of R. marginalis is not reproduced in the text.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate smaller and darker than R. nasutus, antennal segment 3 about as long as segment 1, pronotum relatively small compared with the head. Soldiers of two sizes: major soldier with head slightly rectangular, posterior margin shallowly arcuate, antennae 17-segmented, left mandible with a very small tooth behind the large mid-marginal tooth; minor soldier uniformly red-yellow, head widest at midlength and slightly narrowed posteriorly, antennae 15—16-segmented (mostly 16).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, paler on the occiput and around the antennal bases; with a few long setae; head round, frons with two large muscle attachments between the ocelli. Antennal segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2 and about as long as segment 1, enlarged apically. Eyes rather large, separated from the lower margin of the head by about one quarter of their diameter. Ocelli large, closer to the eyes than their own length. Clypeus paler than the head, distinctly projecting. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, with an indistinct pale V-shaped band medially; with numerous setae; sides rounded, posterior margin very shallowly concave. Wings hyaline, not distinctly pigmented near the wing scales as in R. nasutus, membrane and margins completely bare, without pigment spots. Legs brown. Abdominal tergites brown, slightly darker than the pronotum. Measurements: body with wings 14.50—15.60 mm; body without wings 8.50—10.00 mm; pronotal width 0.93—1.00 mm; hind tibia length 2.40—2.70 mm; forewing length 10.28—11.00 mm, width 3.31—3.41 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Major soldier: body pale red-yellow. Head with a few scattered setae; slightly rectangular, sides slightly rounded, posterior margin shallowly arcuate. Antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 distinctly longer than segments 2 and 4, segment 4 only slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum rather wide, apex rounded, with a longitudinal groove medially. Mandibles dark red-brown, apices long and pointed, slightly curved; left mandible with a large tooth at the middle of the inner margin and a much smaller tooth behind it; right mandible with a large tooth at the middle of the inner margin. Pronotum with a few long setae; sides rounded, posterior margin concave. Measurements: total body length 6.50 mm; head length 3.37 mm; head width 1.99—2.12 mm; antennal length 2.47 mm; pronotal length 0.64 mm, width 1.28 mm; hind tibia length 1.99 mm; left mandible length missing in the original.
Minor soldier: body uniformly red-yellow. Head with about 8 long setae, widest at midlength, slightly narrowed posteriorly. Antennae 15—16-segmented (usually 16), segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 4, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2. Measurements: total body length 3.78 mm; head length 1.54—1.77 mm; head width 0.67—0.70 mm; antennal length 2.25 mm; pronotal length 0.35 mm, width 0.55 mm; hind tibia length 1.19 mm.
